steps.text: The flowers... they're so beautiful.
Have you come to see me again? I don't know today's flowers. Can you teach me how to spell them?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Of course, Narcissa. What do you want to do after you learn it?
I want to put these petals in my picture book, just like I used to.
Mom loved flowers. Dad knew a lot about plants, just like you.
They're not around any more, but I want to record these new flowers, and tell them about them when I visit their graves.
You'll bring me there, right? It's almost April.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Narcissa, my child, you're always the strong one.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Leave the flowers on the table. I'll teach you writing once I'm done with my work.
It smells good. What's for dinner?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Why did you come over here?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Sit down over there. We're having your favorite potato soup.
I'm hungry. Can you cut quicker?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Do you want to help out? No need to be scared, I'll hold your hand.
Like... like this?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Well done. You'll do even better in the future.
The future? Will I grow up to be as tall and strong like you? Become a great scientist?

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: No, you'll be greater than I am. Much greater.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Does the wound on the back of your head still hurt?
Not anymore.
My brothers gave me lots of sweets. They say that one sweet before going to bed helps with the pain, and makes me dream of cotton candy.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Good girl.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: You can have them once you've had dinner. Then there's a place I want to take you to.
Over at the corridor?
The place my brothers went yesterday?
They said there's a nice garden there, just like those in the storybooks, and that's the place you get your flowers.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Familiar Silhouette
steps.text: Those who pass through its doors are blessed by fate.
At the end of the corridor is...

a.text: I can't get the door open! Any ideas, Muelsyse? We need to go!

steps.text: Rosmontis.
Who is Rosmontis?
Who is Narcissa?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Welcome.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're waiting for me?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Always have been.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Where are the Doctor? Where are the others?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Where they were. This court does not need an audience.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Court?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Is this a court? Who's on trial?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I, Loken Williams.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I am both accused and accuser.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: In these last moments, before fate devours me—

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I implore you to witness my life.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Here and now, I confess to all my crimes.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: Greed.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes. My teacher reproached me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: He chided me for my recklessness, and admonished my extraction of infected organs from the dying as being both illegal and immoral.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: He said my actions did not help patients, only accelerated their deaths.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: They were already dying; their consciousness had already passed over to the other side. I did not intend to cause any more pain, nor did I change their fate.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: But my teacher did not agree. He and his teacher pronounced my death sentence in academia, in a private trial with no justice to speak of.

spans.text: But my teacher did not agree. He and
teacher pronounced my death sentence in academia, in a private trial with no justice to speak of.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: They refused to admit that greed is a virtue for a scientist.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: A small-town boy's biology education is limited to delivering burdenbeast calves, unless he musters the courage to dissect the newborn calf in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: The thirst for knowledge was enough to overcome his empathy. He needed to seize every opportunity to climb, to continue on the path of exploration.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: Cowardice.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I have not often been found wanting of courage, but there was one thing that I yielded to.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Maylander banned me after my teacher reported me, a mark of shame that shut me out of all universities and government-sponsored research institutions.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: It was the cruelest punishment you could inflict on a scientist in his prime. They stripped me of my right to research. It was akin to murder of the soul.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I began drowning myself in drink. For a year and ten months, I forced myself to face my trembling hands, so that I could forget the pain of not being able to hold a scalpel.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: That was when they found me.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: They. The shameless rascals.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: The Department of Defense. They funded Loken Watertank. In return, I was to develop the most powerful weapon for them in five years.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Science is neutral, pure, and free. Practical value, especially in terms of weaponization, can only be a burden for science.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I did not want to contribute my research for them, but they knew what my weakness was.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Knowledge is expensive. Instruments, equipment, materials, down to the bricks that make up the laboratory—it all takes money.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Building the lab of my dreams costs more than building a skyscraper in the middle of Trimounts.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I had to admit my weakness and prostrate myself before their power.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: How pathetic.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Is this nation any less so? They have allowed barbaric power to control the lifeline of science!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: There is no one more short-sighted than the soldier. They are at the helm of science, yet they know not how to use such precious knowledge except to kill their own kind.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: Folly.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes, folly. The most unforgiveable crime that a scientist can commit.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: The foolish soldiers are easy to deceive. Getting subcutaneous Arts units, the result of billions in investment, was enough to satisfy them.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: But I was too busy, too obsessed with my research, to realize the weakness and ambition of those around me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: A foolish student of mine handed part of my experiment data to the Department of Defense.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: They learned what Loken Watertank was really researching, and were eager to see results, even threatening to take direct control.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: How could I allow them to steal my dream, when I was so close to finishing my masterpiece?!

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: You took a risk. You failed.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: You lost everything.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: Narcissa destroyed your lab. That wasn't so bad, but then Maylander came again. They took Narcissa, robbed you of your dream again.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: You were like a walking corpse. The Department of Defense confiscated the scraps, then wanted you to repay the billions of investment. You could not repay it, and you refused to work with them anymore.

steps.name: 'Loken'
steps.text: So you were thrown into prison, like a piece of rotting meat that no one paid any further attention too.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: That was my greatest crime—failure!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Now, my final and greatest failure stands before me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Narcissa!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: The only flower in my garden that has not been trampled into the mud. Broken, but still beautiful.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Look at me. Look at the Loken Williams who raised you, educated you, oppressed you, tormented you.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You witnessed me, inches away from the summit, and witnessed my fall from grace into the abyss.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Now I invite you, child, to be the stick that measures my pain, my regrets, my crimes.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You are the only one fit to do so.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Push forward!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Area suppressed!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Gamma and Delta?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: No more reinforcing power armors!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Excellent. Continue the attack and prepare to breach the building.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Not so fast.

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Colonel!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Should I start with you?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Will killing you buy more time?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You... traitor!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Traitor? We have always been enemies. Who have I betrayed?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Argh—*cough*—

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: How fragile.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Should I have done this a long time ago? You almost killed our beloved Vice President. Maybe I can exchange your head for a pardon.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: All units...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Attack...!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You want to be a martyr.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Perhaps I should oblige.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh, there you are, hero.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The military and Maylander have this building surrounded. You can't win.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Win?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's not victory that I'm looking for. It's a chance.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Same for Kristen.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No chance is worth so many lives, including your own.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You think so?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Compared to my knowledge, my own life has always been insignificant.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I've seen so much history, but to time, I'm hardly even a passing breeze.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: That's my life. My poor, boring life.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: A tiny little bit of time, for the chance to touch eternal knowledge, even for an instant—how can it not be worth it?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You're even fascinated by death.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Don't get me wrong. I'm just... curious.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I know thousands of ways to die, over hundreds, thousands of years of history. But I only get to die once.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Period. Full-stop, standing between accumulated memories, and the possibilities of the future. How does it feel?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You'll find out.

a.text:
There was no enamel blade growth.
Saria simply focused all her strength on her hand.

There was no Originium Arts involved.
That is why the fist was able to penetrate the distorted air.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh dear, looks like I've lost.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I guess that's it, Saria. Kill me here, and make it quick. Or maybe not so quick. I should savor the moment. I only get one chance, after all.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You... madwoman.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: What about you? Did you think yourself a creature of reason in all that you do?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You wanted to prevent disaster in the most efficient manner. You're standing at the door. Why don't you work with the military?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: They tend to make things worse.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: What about Maylander?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: They have been your firm allies for the past five years. They made the decision to work with the military.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh, and the adorable little Liberi.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: The little brown bird, so full of morality and empathy. I saw her in one of the military aircraft.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I didn't know you had that expression in you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Your hands are growing weaker. Everything is going out of control, even your own heart. Is that not a strange feeling to a woman like you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Your taunts are meaningless.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Poor Saria. That's not what your eyes, your hands, every inch of your body is saying.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Are you sure you don't want to run over to the lab there right this instant?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It may already be too late.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You—
In an instant, Ho'olheyak is standing on top of a half-collapsed wall.
A few more leaps, and she is gone from the battlefield.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: The door to the lab is broken... how could it be?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Loken...!

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Well, time is almost up anyway.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Might as well call it a day.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're Loken.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You came to the orphanage every Friday evening.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You brought different flowers each time.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Your clothes always had a strong smell to them. The smell of swimming pools and freshly painted fences.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I didn't really mind that smell. I wanted to tell you that you didn't need to hide it with flowers.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But I didn't say anything because I liked your flowers. I liked the stories of plants that you told. It reminded me of Dad.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Good, good! Your memories are coming back!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes, I'm remembering.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You used to be very nice to me. Then you became very mean.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I'm sorry, child, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I promised you... I wanted to give you a happy future.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You and your brothers should have been the perfect lifeforms.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You would have redefined Originium Arts, freed yourselves from the shackles of talent, the plague of Oripathy.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes, you... no, we should have conquered fate itself together.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Why? Why couldn't I do it? I ruined us both!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why are you crying?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Tears falling on the hand. Salty. Painful.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I have seen you cry before.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: That day... no, I don't want to remember.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't want you in my memories. It's painful to forget, but even more painful to remember you.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Don't forget.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Remember me. Please, remember me. Remember the criminal.
Filled with guilt.
Filled with pain.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: My brothers...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why... why? Why! My memories are coming back... my head hurts... it's cold!

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Grab me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Grab my neck. Clutch it in your hands. Do you feel the pulsating veins? The blood is warm. You won't be cold anymore.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Blood... how could it be warm?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's colder than ice, more suffocating than water.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's all you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You took my life and my brothers away.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You turned me into... into...
A monster.
A weapon.
A destroyer.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Then kill me. Destroy my broken body. Crush my guilty soul. For all that you've lost.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kill you...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Will all the crimes disappear if I kill you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The lives that people should have lived won't be taken away again? They can be with the ones they love?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: ...I can't lie to you anymore.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: But at least I deserve it.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Time is short. We'll have company soon.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll go to them.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I won't let anyone... stand in the way of what's right.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor, the army men are coming!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We need to go deeper! Hurry!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Old Loken's locked the door! This building is like a maze. It's got Nasti's handprints all over it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We've been at it for a while now, but we still have no clue where they are.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm concerned about the kitten... but I doubt an old, sickly scientist like Loken could do anything to her.

options: He wants to retrieve Rosmontis's memories.
He wants to incite Rosmontis's anger.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did he finally go off the deep end? They say being in prison too long makes you go crazy.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But... well, I'm not sure I should say it, but the kitten has a reason to be angry after Loken did all that to her, doesn't she?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I was angry when I saw Iffy's experiment logs, angry enough that I wanted to flood those ruins six feet deep.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Loken would be getting what he deserved. Assuming, just assuming, that Rosmontis really had vengeance on her mind... I'm not sure I'm really in a position to stop her...

options: I just don't want Loken to get what he wants.
I just want Rosmontis to do what she wants.
I want to be with my family.
I want to help my operator.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Then we'd better hurry...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Eek—!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Th-That was close...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We almost got roasted together!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Army power armors! Get inside!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor, we have to—
Over here!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Am I starting to hear things? Why do I feel like I just heard Iffy's voice?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Come with me!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: What's wrong with you? Step on it! You FNG or something?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator?
steps.text: Y-YOU'RE the FNG!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's sounding more and more like...

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Target, 3 o'clock!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Nngh?!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator?
steps.text: So that's how it works? It's so complicated... I'd rather use my fire...

spans.text: how it works? It's so complicated... I'd rather use my fire...

steps.text: The power armor convulses a few times before you.
Then, a fiery red girl leaps out in a shower of sparks.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Doctor? MuMu? You're both here!

options: Isn't this thing supposed to be a nightmare to drive?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: It's a piece of cake for a genius like me!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Alright, well, Saria modified it, so she's the genius. Ask her the details. She's close.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Saria's here too?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: If only she would let me do stuff myself. But why don't you look happy, MuMu?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's not that...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Wait, that's the way Rosmontis went... the power armor went there?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Go, go, go!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Hostile conta—er, it's a young girl. Sensors indicate the presence of an elderly male further in.

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Should we proc—wait!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Giant floating weapons!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: High-threat target identified! Attack!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're... a soldier.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Cold outer shell... no warmth, no emotion.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Are you fighting bad people? Do you stand with the people who have been hurt?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Possible unidentified high-threat test subject!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Requesting permission to engage—

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, you don't have your own will.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You don't think about right and wrong before you act, do you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then, you're just a puppet on strings.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Go away, or I'll destroy you too.
